import cv2, numpy as np
from scipy.signal import find_peaks,peak_widths
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
p='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png'
im=cv2.imread(p,cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
assert im.shape==(724,724)
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in [('A',(65,220,420,540)),('B',(65,350,400,660)),('C',(170,330,465,610))]:
 gray=im[y0:y1,x0:x1]
 edges=cv2.Canny(cv2.GaussianBlur(gray,(3,3),0),45,110)
 ls=cv2.HoughLinesP(edges,1,np.pi/1800,threshold=20,minLineLength=18,maxLineGap=6)
 dat=[]
 if ls is not None:
  for x,y,xe,ye in ls.reshape(-1,4):
   dx=int(xe-x);dy=int(ye-y);length=float(np.hypot(dx,dy));angle=float(np.degrees(np.arctan2(dy,dx)))%180
   if length>=22: dat.append((angle,length,[int(x+x0),int(y+y0),int(xe+x0),int(ye+y0)]))
 hist=np.histogram([d[0] for d in dat],bins=np.arange(0,182,2),weights=[d[1] for d in dat])[0]
 top=np.argsort(hist)[-12:][::-1]
 print('ROI',name,(x0,y0,x1,y1),'HOUGH_CNT',len(dat),'ANGLE_TOP_WEIGHTED',[(int(k*2),round(float(hist[k]),1)) for k in top],flush=True)
 for target in [45,50,55,60,65,90]:
  li=[d for d in dat if abs(d[0]-target)<=5]
  if li: print('ANGLE_GROUP',name,target,'CNT',len(li),'MEAN_ANGLE',round(float(np.average([d[0] for d in li],weights=[d[1] for d in li])),3),'LONGEST',sorted(li,key=lambda v:-v[1])[:5],flush=True)
 # Project image darkness onto normals of candidate 45/50/55/60 deg oriented wires.
 for theta in [45,50,55,60,65]:
  a=np.radians(theta); y,x=np.indices(gray.shape)
  normal=-np.sin(a)*(x+x0)+np.cos(a)*(y+y0)
  idx=np.floor(normal*2).astype(int); idx-=idx.min();n=idx.max()+1
  weights=255-gray.astype(float)
  avg=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),weights=weights.ravel(),minlength=n)/np.maximum(1,np.bincount(idx.ravel(),minlength=n))
  count=np.bincount(idx.ravel(),minlength=n)
  valid=count>80
  baseline=gaussian_filter1d(avg,20)
  resid=gaussian_filter1d(avg,1)-baseline
  resid[~valid]=-1e5
  peaks,prop=find_peaks(resid,prominence=3,distance=13)
  peaks=peaks[(peaks>15)&(peaks<n-15)]
  gaps=np.diff(peaks)/2
  if len(gaps): print('PROJECTION',name,theta,'PEAKS',len(peaks),'GAP_MEDIAN',round(float(np.median(gaps)),2),'GAP_ARR',np.round(gaps[:28],2).tolist(),'PROM_RANGE',round(float(np.max(resid[peaks])),2),flush=True)
